question.prompt: A unit of blood expires after \[10! = 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdots 1\] seconds. Yasin donates a unit of blood at noon on January \(1.\) On what day does his unit of blood expire?

solutions.title: Convert seconds to days
solutions.explanation:
Convert the lifetime to days before counting forward on the calendar. One day contains \(24\cdot60\cdot60=86{,}400\) seconds, so the lifetime in days is
\[
\frac{10!}{86{,}400}
=\frac{3{,}628{,}800}{86{,}400}
=42.
\]
January has \(31\) days, so noon on February 1 is \(31\) days after the donation. There are \(42-31=11\) days left, taking us to noon on \(\boxed{\text{February 12}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
